Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding food refrigeration and freezing standards.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to food refrigeration and freezing standards; andadding a new section to chapter 70.05 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.05 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: No local health jurisdiction may establish standards forrefrigerating or freezing food that requires a business to purchase aspecified type of refrigeration or freezing equipment if therefrigeration or freezing equipment that the business uses: (1) Is capable of complying with the temperature standards adoptedby the state board of health; and (2) Was manufactured after January 1, 2000.
